Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand For the Petitioner : Mr. Prashant Kumar
Rai, Advocate For the State : Ms. Sushma Aind, A.P.P.
--------
Order No. 02/ dated 13.09.2024 Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.P.P. for
the State.

2. This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant-Vijay Singh @ Vijay Kumar Singh
with the prayer to release on bail in connection with Bengabad P.S. Case No. 123 of 2023, registered
under Sections 376/417/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of the learned Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Giridih.

3.  The F.I.R. of this case was lodged by the victim wherein the allegations are made that the sister of the victim was married on 12.07.2019 with Vijay Singh and a female baby was also born out of the very wedlock.
Thereafter her sister died in March, 2021.
Thereafter the family members of Vijay proposed for marriage of Vijay Singh with the informant/victim.
Members of both the family agreed for the same.
Thereafter Vijay Singh continued to establish physical relation with her and ultimately Vijay Singh and his family members refused to marry.
Hence this F.I.R. was lodged.
4. The victim in her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. also corroborated the prosecution story.

In the F.I.R. itself the age of victim is shown 23 years old and from the very allegations made in the F.I.R. the victim and the petitioner and family members of both were agreed for the marriage but the marriage was not solemnized and physical relation continued to establish between the two.

The victim being major 23 years old had been establishing physical relation with the petitioner without getting married knowing well the consequences of the same and being aware that without marriage the physical relation being established the conduct of the victim is found consensual.
